TOTO Prize Structure

TOTO is a lottery where you choose 6 numbers from 1 to 49. A minimum bet is $1.

The Prize Pool for each draw is 54% of the sales for that draw. The Prize Pool is shared among the prize groups as follows.

Prize Group
Winning Numbers Matched
Prize Amount
Group 1
6 numbers
38% of Prize Pool (Minimum $1,000,000)
Group 2
5 numbers + Additional number
8% of Prize Pool
Group 3
5 numbers
5.5% of Prize Pool
Group 4
4 numbers + Additional number
3% of Prize Pool
Group 5
4 numbers
$50 per winning share
Group 6
3 numbers + Additional number
$25 per winning share
Group 7
3 numbers
$10 per winning share

Snowball and Cascade

If there is no winning share in Group 1, the prize amount snowballs to the next draw. The snowball is capped at 4 draws, after which the Group 1 prize cascades to the next winning prize group.
